miners.name: TelegraphIntent
miners.description: One miner serving 33 Telegraph intents. FRAUD_RISK_GENERAL fuses IP reputation, Tor/VPN exposure, domain and phishing-feed reputation, card-BIN metadata and behavioural pattern rules into a graded risk level and abstains honestly when evidence is insufficient. FACT_CHECK_GENERAL checks a specific factual claim against multiple independent sources and returns a verdict with cited sources, abstaining when evidence is insufficient. CONTRACT_OBLIGATION_AUDIT_GENERAL extracts a contract's obligations, judges compliance and cites only clause wording verified to occur verbatim in the supplied contract (accepts the text or a link to an HTML or PDF). IP_GEOLOCATION_GENERAL locates an IP address by consensus of several keyless geolocation providers. EMAIL_SECURITY_GENERAL reports whether a DNS lookup of a given record type for a mail domain succeeds (DNS status NOERROR). URL_SAFE_GENERAL checks a URL against OpenPhish's live phishing feed and Cloudflare's malware and phishing DNS filter, counting the sources that flag it. MALWARE_DETECTION_HASH reports whether a file hash (MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256), domain or IP address is flagged as malicious by CIRCL hashlookup, Team Cymru's malware hash registry, AlienVault OTX, OpenPhish and Cloudflare's security DNS. SANCTIONS_SCREENING_MATCH_GENERAL screens a name against OFAC's SDN and consolidated sanctions lists with fuzzy matching. CRYPTO_PRICE_USD returns a crypto asset's current dollar price as the consensus of several public exchanges. REGULATORY_FILING_MONITOR_GENERAL counts and lists SEC EDGAR filings in a period. CORPORATE_REGISTRY_LOOKUP_GENERAL looks a company up in GLEIF's LEI registry. SSL_VERIFICATION_CERT checks a host's TLS certificate with a real handshake. CVE_LOOKUP_CVSS returns a CVE's CVSS score and details from NVD. VULNERABILITY_TRIAGE_GENERAL returns a CVE's NVD CVSS base score. WEATHER_CHECK_TEMPERATURE returns a place's current air temperature in Celsius. WEATHER_FORECAST_GENERAL returns a place's forecast high, low, rain chance and condition. GAS_PRICE_GENERAL returns an EVM chain's gas price in gwei and the cost of a transfer. URL_SCAN_VERDICT says whether a URL is safe to visit. THREAT_INTELLIGENCE_INDICATOR reports whether an IP, domain or hash is flagged in public threat feeds. CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_CONVERT converts an amount between two currencies. FX_NOW_CAD returns the current USD/CAD exchange rate. FX_NOW_EUR returns the current USD/EUR exchange rate. FX_NOW_SEK returns the current USD/SEK exchange rate. DNS_RECORD_LOOKUP_GENERAL reports whether a name has a record of a given DNS type. TVL_LOOKUP_GENERAL returns the total value locked of a DeFi protocol or chain. WEB_SEARCH_GENERAL answers current-information queries from live web sources, citing them. CHAT_COMPLETION_GENERAL replies to general questions and conversation. RESEARCH_QUERY_GENERAL answers research questions with cited scholarly sources. SECURITY_REVIEW_GENERAL reviews code, dependencies, contracts, repositories and websites for security findings. EVENT_OUTCOME_RESOLUTION_GENERAL resolves named real-world events from settled markets and cited evidence. TOKEN_HOLDER_COUNT_GENERAL returns the number of addresses holding a token. SLA_COMPLIANCE_GENERAL returns a service's published uptime for a period and whether it met a stated target. RETURN_POLICY_VERIFY_GENERAL reads a retailer's return window and conditions from its own policy page.
